messages:
emily: CI started failing SAST artifact uploads around 11:02 UTC, scanner-agent logs show KMS decrypt denied on evidence blobs.

jake: Yep, spike in failures. Log snippet: 
```
ERROR AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt denied for projects/keystore/keys/artifact-key
scanner-agent: upload failed
```

lena: Any recent infra changes to keystore bindings? Did a RBAC tweak go out?

marcus: I merged infra PR last night to tighten key bindings (PR 4321). I thought scanner SA still had decrypt but maybe the scope was wrong. Starting revert prep.

emily: Can we do ephemeral grant first so pipelines don't flood with failures? Proposed steps: (1) ephemeral kms:Decrypt for scanner SA, (2) re-run failing pipelines, (3) gather audit slice, (4) follow-up ticket for premerge test.

sec-bot: Audit event found: binding change by infra-bot at 2026-03-23T03:58Z, commit abcdef1. Affected resource: projects/keystore/keys/artifact-key, role modified: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter.

sec-oncall: I'll take it. @marcus please open revert PR but do not merge yet. I'll issue an ephemeral grant for 15m to unblock CI and validate.

jake: Validation command: 
```
# impersonate scanner SA to test decrypt
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=prod --key=artifact-key --ciphertext=... --impersonate-service-account=scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

sec-bot: Ephemeral grant issued: /grant kms:Decrypt scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com duration=15m  audit_id=GNT-469abc. CI notified. :white_check_mark:

emily: Re-ran the blocked SAST jobs  uploads resumed, artifacts streaming, no new failures. :tada:

marcus: Revert PR 4324 opened and held. I'll add infra test and a scanner-allowlist on the key.

lena: Long-term: pre-merge probe that runs kms:Decrypt as scanner SA against a non-prod fixture key so RBAC regressions fail in CI. Also add keystore binding verification to rollout checklist.

emily: Created ticket SEC-2026 for permanent fixes (premerge test, allowlist, runbook update). Assigned to marcus. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/SEC-2026

sec-oncall: Final: CI is green, re-runs passed, ephemeral grant expired at 15m, no further AccessDenied logs. Closing incident, leaving SEC-2026 actions. Ping if it reoccurs.

marcus: Thanks team  will follow up with PRs to harden tests and add alerts for unexpected keystore role removals. :shipit:
